reporting-org.narrative: ORRAAs mission is to build the resilience of 250 million climate vulnerable coastal people by 2030, by deploying at least USD$500 million of investment into coastal and ocean resilience through the development of at least 50 novel finance and insurance products.

description.narrative: Coast 4C is building the world’s largest regenerative seaweed value chain, supporting marginalized small-scale farmers in climate-vulnerable coastal communities. By integrating improved equipment, sustainable practices, and inclusive financial services, including farm finance and crop insurance,Coast 4C enhances resilience and productivity. Our iMPA model links regenerative seaweed farming with marine protection, driving environmental and economic sustainability. This initiative aims to scale farm input packages, monitor ecosystem impacts, and catalyze financial innovations to uplift seaweed farmers and combat poverty.
